name: Engine (Powertrain)
functionality: Converts fuel or electrical energy into mechanical power to drive the wheels.

name: Transmission
functionality: Transfers engine power to the wheels and adjusts gear ratios for speed and torque.

name: Fuel System
functionality: Stores, filters and delivers fuel to the engine at the correct pressure and rate.

name: Exhaust & Emissions System
functionality: Routes combustion gases away and reduces harmful emissions via the catalytic converter and muffler.

name: Cooling System
functionality: Circulates coolant through radiator and engine to keep operating temperature in range.

name: Lubrication System
functionality: Pumps oil to moving parts to reduce friction, wear and heat build-up.

name: Electrical & Charging System
functionality: Battery, alternator and wiring supply power for starting, ignition, lights and electronics.

name: Ignition & Starting System
functionality: Cranks the engine and ignites the air-fuel mixture at the right moment.

name: Braking System
functionality: Slows and stops the vehicle using discs/drums, hydraulics, ABS and the parking brake.

name: Steering System
functionality: Lets the driver control direction; power assist reduces effort at the wheel.

name: Suspension System
functionality: Springs, dampers and linkages absorb road shock and keep tyres in contact with the road.

name: Wheels & Tyres
functionality: Provide grip, carry vehicle load and transmit traction and braking forces to the road.

name: Chassis & Body
functionality: Structural frame and panels that support all components and protect occupants in a crash.

name: Safety & Restraint System
functionality: Seat belts, airbags and crash sensors that protect occupants during impact.

name: Driver Assistance (ADAS)
functionality: Cameras, radar and software for cruise control, lane keeping, parking aid and collision warning.

name: HVAC (Climate Control)
functionality: Heats, cools, ventilates and defogs the cabin for comfort and visibility.

name: Lighting & Signalling
functionality: Headlights, indicators and brake lights for visibility and communicating intent.

name: Infotainment & Telematics
functionality: Audio, navigation, connectivity and vehicle data communication.

name: Onboard Computers & Sensors (ECU/CAN bus)
functionality: Monitor and control engine, transmission and body functions; run diagnostics over the CAN network.
